title: Languages encoding a computation
statement: Let $f$ be a function from finite Boolean lists to finite Boolean lists, and let $m$ be a Boolean flag. Define a language of Boolean lists consisting of those $z$ for which deleting the first two entries of $z$ yields a list in the indexed language whose predicate at input $x$ and index $i$ holds exactly when either $m$ is true and $i<|f(x)|$, or $m$ is false and the $i$th entry of $f(x)$ (taken to be false when the index is out of range) is true.
hypotheses_covered: function f from Boolean lists to Boolean lists
